summary: Verified Atlas-only data-source status feature: admin sees connected status + read-only Learning Queue evidence (29 records), teacher is denied both the route and API, and the exact outage copy ships in the frontend. Backend suite: 80/80 passed. Browser checks: 5/5 passed.

checks.criterion: Administrator can open the Atlas-only data-source status view
checks.name: admin-data-source-status-view
checks.evidence: Logged in as admin@vidya.com, navigated to /admin/data-source. data-source-page visible, connection-status text 'Atlas connected'. Page body contains no mongodb+srv/connection-string text.

checks.criterion: Administrator can open the Atlas-only data-source status view (API)
checks.name: test_admin_can_inspect_atlas_status_and_learning_queue
checks.evidence: GET /api/admin/data-source-status with admin token -> 200, {source: 'MongoDB Atlas', available: true, message contains 'Atlas connected'}; no mongo_url/connection_string keys in payload.

checks.criterion: Learning Queue inspection is read-only and evidence-focused
checks.name: admin-data-source-status-view
checks.evidence: data-source-queue-count parsed as integer > 0; first queue row exposes title, owner, scope, created and updated cells (data-testid queue-title/owner/scope/created/updated) all visible.

checks.criterion: Data-source diagnostics are restricted to administrators
checks.name: teacher-denied-data-source-status
checks.evidence: Logged in as teacher@vidya.com, navigated to /admin/data-source. data-source-page and data-source-queue-table both not visible (route/UI gated by role).

checks.criterion: Data-source diagnostics are restricted to administrators (API)
checks.name: test_teacher_cannot_access_data_source_diagnostics

checks.criterion: Database outage copy is present on the protected experience
checks.name: outage-copy-present-in-bundle
checks.evidence: Fetched served frontend JS bundle(s) via page.request without inducing an outage; exact string 'Database unavailable. Contact Dhruv immediately.' found in bundle. Source review confirms DatabaseUnavailableOverlay.js and DataSourceStatus.js both render DATABASE_UNAVAILABLE_MESSAGE from lib/api.js verbatim.

checks.criterion: Backend suite regression (all prior + data-source tests)
checks.name: full backend pytest suite
checks.evidence: cd /app/backend && python -m pytest -q -> 80 passed, 6 warnings (pre-existing deprecation warnings only) in 62.31s.
